name: Snow Falling In Love
source:
Your summer getaway magically turns on its head when snow falls early in the small town of Emerald Creek. But could a quest to escape an endless winter also lead to an endless love?

[From [url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/snow-falling-in-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当翡翠溪小镇初雪初降时，你的夏日度假之旅将神奇地发生翻天覆地的变化。但逃离无尽冬天的追求是否也能带来无尽的爱呢？

[来自[url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/snow-falling-in-love]Itch.io[/url]]
